title: Reading Candlestick Charts
description: How to interpret the most famous stock charts.

slides.title: More than just a line
slides.content: A basic line chart only shows the closing price. A 'Candlestick' shows the Open, High, Low, and Close (OHLC) for a specific time period (like one day).

slides.title: The Body and Wicks
slides.content: The thick 'body' shows the difference between the open and close price. The thin lines (wicks) on top and bottom show the highest and lowest price reached that day.

slides.title: Green vs Red
slides.content: If the close is higher than the open, the candle is Green (Bullish). If the close is lower than the open, it's Red (Bearish).

quiz.question: What do the thin lines (wicks/shadows) on a candlestick represent?

options.text: The highest and lowest prices reached during that period
options.explanation: Wicks show the extremes of price movement before settling.

options.text: The closing price was higher than the opening price
options.explanation: Green means the price went up during that session.

options.text: The closing price was lower than the opening price
